lines.zh: 我在浅水里走，袍下摆全湿了
lines.en: I walk the shallows, my robe hem soaked.

lines.zh: 湿透的衣角拖出一道水痕
lines.en: My wet hem leaves a trail of water.

lines.zh: 木屐踩进淤泥，发出咕唧声
lines.en: My sandals squelch in the silt.

lines.zh: 我飘起一段，不全靠腿
lines.en: I drift a stretch, not trusting only legs.

lines.zh: 海水的味道盖过我的呼吸
lines.en: The smell of seawater covers my breath.

lines.zh: 我把法杖横在身前
lines.en: I hold the staff across my body.

lines.zh: 袍子底下的东西在动
lines.en: Something under the robe is moving.

lines.zh: 我绕着礁石走了半圈
lines.en: I circle the reef for half a turn.

lines.zh: 木门挡路，我一推就开
lines.en: A wooden door blocks me; one push opens it.

lines.zh: 我散开成几片影子又合上
lines.en: I scatter into shadows and come back together.

lines.zh: 我站在潮线上，海水漫到脚踝
lines.en: I stand at the tide line, water to my ankles.

lines.zh: 袍帽下看不清脸
lines.en: Under my hood there is no clear face.

lines.zh: 法杖插在沙里，杖头发暗
lines.en: My staff stands in the sand, its head dim.

lines.zh: 我在听海，也在听你
lines.en: I listen to the sea, and to you.

lines.zh: 浅滩上有鱼在跳
lines.en: Fish leap in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我把手指伸进水里
lines.en: I put my fingers in the water.

lines.zh: 潮水退了一寸，我记住了
lines.en: The tide fell an inch; I noted it.

lines.zh: 我不需要眨眼，也不需要呼吸
lines.en: I need not blink, nor breathe.

lines.zh: 衣袖里滴出海水
lines.en: Seawater drips from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 远处的村落有灯
lines.en: There are lamps in the far village.

lines.zh: 我把法杖从沙里拔出来
lines.en: I pull the staff from the sand.

lines.zh: 潮线在我脚边画了一道
lines.en: The tide line draws a mark at my feet.

lines.zh: 沙子从我的袍摆里漏出来
lines.en: Sand leaks from the hem of my robe.

lines.zh: 我在等退潮，也在等涨潮
lines.en: I wait for the ebb, and for the flood.

lines.zh: 浅水里有东西在叫我
lines.en: Something in the shallows is calling me.

lines.zh: 我把袍帽压低了些
lines.en: I pull my hood a little lower.

lines.zh: 我从袍帽下看你
lines.en: I look at you from beneath my hood.

lines.zh: 你的气很淡，像受伤的鱼
lines.en: Your aura is faint, like a wounded fish.

lines.zh: 我在想，你会不会也变成我们
lines.en: I wonder whether you will become one of us.

lines.zh: 把手伸给我吧
lines.en: Hold out your hand.

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，海水涨了
lines.en: When I speak, the tide rises.

lines.zh: 幻影术换了海嗣的皮，还是幻。
lines.en: Illusion wearing seaborn skin is still illusion.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水里分成三个
lines.en: My shadow splits into three in the water.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，鞋陷进泥里
lines.en: You step back and your shoe sinks in mud.

lines.zh: 这片岸已经属于大群
lines.en: This shore belongs to the swarm.

lines.zh: 你听见的那阵潮声，不是潮
lines.en: That surf you hear is not the tide.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指了指海
lines.en: I raise a hand and point at the sea.

lines.zh: 你的命在我手里像条小鱼
lines.en: Your life is a small fish in my hand.

lines.zh: 我的袍子被割开，露出里面的东西
lines.en: My robe is cut open, showing what is inside.

lines.zh: 海水从我身上流走了一些
lines.en: Some seawater drains out of me.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，水花很低
lines.en: I step back and the splash is low.

lines.zh: 我的法杖歪了
lines.en: My staff tilts.

lines.zh: 袍帽下的暗处晃了一下
lines.en: The dark under my hood shifts.

lines.zh: 我捂住被砍的地方
lines.en: I cover the cut place.

lines.zh: 大群在我身下骚动
lines.en: The swarm stirs beneath me.

lines.zh: 我重新站直，袍子下垂
lines.en: I straighten, the robe hanging wet.

lines.zh: 被割的地方渗出海水
lines.en: Seawater seeps from the cut.

lines.zh: 我按住杖头，光暗下去
lines.en: I press the staff's head and its light fades.

lines.zh: 你带的食物有陆地的味道
lines.en: Your food smells of dry land.

lines.zh: 我早就不用嘴吃了
lines.en: I stopped eating with a mouth long ago.

lines.zh: 可我还记得面包的味道
lines.en: But I remember the taste of bread.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我抬起了手
lines.en: You hold it up and I raise a hand.

lines.zh: 这一点东西，不够喂大群
lines.en: This is not enough to feed the swarm.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，没有拒绝
lines.en: I sniff it and do not refuse.

lines.zh: 你先尝一口，我看看
lines.en: Take a bite first; let me see.

lines.zh: 海水从我的袖口滴在它上面
lines.en: Seawater drips from my sleeve onto it.

lines.zh: 我把它托在掌心，很轻
lines.en: I hold it in my palm; it is very light.

lines.zh: 我尝了一点，味道很旧
lines.en: I taste a little; the flavor is old.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的袍子，像撞湿布
lines.en: You hit my robe like hitting wet cloth.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，水里裂开一道缝
lines.en: I turn aside and a seam opens in the water.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞进我的影子
lines.en: Your shoulder enters my shadow.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，把你推开半尺
lines.en: I raise a hand and push you half a foot.

lines.zh: 湿透的衣料贴在身上
lines.en: The wet cloth clings to me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，水花溅起
lines.en: I take a step back and water splashes.

lines.zh: 你撞进我怀里，我袍子散开
lines.en: You crash into me and my robe opens.

lines.zh: 湿沙被我们踩出两个坑
lines.en: Our feet press two hollows in wet sand.

lines.zh: 我的杖横过来，挡住你
lines.en: My staff comes across to stop you.

lines.zh: 海浪把我们推开一点
lines.en: A wave pushes us a little apart.

lines.zh: 大群里没有夫妻，只有同体
lines.en: In the swarm there are no pairs, only one body.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，像两片浪
lines.en: We lean together like two waves.

lines.zh: 她的袍子上有珊瑚的痕
lines.en: Her robe bears coral marks.

lines.zh: 我把她肩上的海草拂掉
lines.en: I brush the seaweed from her shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，用潮声交谈
lines.en: We speak not in words but in tide sounds.

lines.zh: 两副影子在水里合成一片
lines.en: Our two shadows merge in the water.

lines.zh: 我替她把法杖扶正
lines.en: I set her staff upright.

lines.zh: 她的手在水里比我的凉
lines.en: Her hand in the water is colder than mine.

lines.zh: 我们同看一个方向
lines.en: We look the same way.

lines.zh: 潮水上来，盖过我们的脚
lines.en: The tide comes up over our feet.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，指尖碰到湿沙
lines.en: I bend and my fingertips touch wet sand.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚被磨圆的贝壳
lines.en: I pick up a shell worn round.

lines.zh: 把它贴在耳边，里面有声音
lines.en: I hold it to my ear; there is a voice inside.

lines.zh: 我拾起一根断掉的法杖
lines.en: I pick up a broken staff.

lines.zh: 海草缠上我的手腕
lines.en: Seaweed winds around my wrist.

lines.zh: 掉在水里的东西，我捞起来
lines.en: I fish what fell into the water out.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片湿透的布
lines.en: I pick up a soaked scrap of cloth.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚鱼骨
lines.en: I pick up a fish bone.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进袖里
lines.en: I tuck it into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的杖头饰
lines.en: I pick up a fallen staff ornament.

lines.zh: 我抬起法杖，杖头亮了
lines.en: I raise the staff and its head kindles.

lines.zh: 潮水开始往岸上推
lines.en: The tide begins to push inland.

lines.zh: 你站在我要占的地方
lines.en: You stand where I mean to take.

lines.zh: 我的袍角散开，像网
lines.en: My robe spreads out like a net.

lines.zh: 海嗣的气味浓起来了
lines.en: The smell of seaborn thickens.

lines.zh: 我不用喊，潮声会替我喊
lines.en: I need not shout; the surf shouts for me.

lines.zh: 你的位置我记住了，海岸线也一样。
lines.en: I have your position, and the coastline too.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，是为了起手
lines.en: I step back half a pace to wind up.

lines.zh: 我抬起另一只手，两杖同指
lines.en: I raise the other hand; both point at you.

lines.zh: 岸边的水开始转圈
lines.en: The water at the shore starts to turn.

lines.zh: 我的袍角伸进海里
lines.en: My robe's hem reaches into the sea.

lines.zh: 我让影子先绕过去
lines.en: I send a shadow around first.

lines.zh: 你身边的沙开始下陷
lines.en: The sand beside you starts to sink.

lines.zh: 我把杖尖压低，对着你的脚
lines.en: I lower the staff's tip at your feet.

lines.zh: 这座岸，我今晚就要
lines.en: Tonight I take this shore.

lines.zh: 我数着潮水的节奏
lines.en: I count the rhythm of the tide.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸和潮声不同步
lines.en: Your breathing is out of step with the surf.

lines.zh: 我开口，声音像水底
lines.en: I speak, and my voice comes from the seabed.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，水跟着转
lines.en: I circle you and the water turns with me.

lines.zh: 三个影子把你围住
lines.en: Three shadows surround you.

lines.zh: 我的法杖指哪，浪就拍哪
lines.en: Where my staff points, the wave strikes.

lines.zh: 你退到干沙上，那也在岸边
lines.en: You retreat to dry sand; it is still the shore.

lines.zh: 潮水一寸寸往上爬
lines.en: The tide climbs inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我在等这一片涨潮
lines.en: I am waiting for this whole tide.

lines.zh: 你的脚陷得越来越深
lines.en: Your feet sink deeper and deeper.

lines.zh: 我不急，海水有的是
lines.en: I am patient; the sea has plenty of time.

lines.zh: 我把杖尖在水面点了两下
lines.en: I tap the staff twice on the water's face.

lines.zh: 浪声盖住你的脚步
lines.en: The surf drowns out your steps.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把你赶向深水
lines.en: Step by step I drive you toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 你在沙上留下的印越来越乱
lines.en: The prints you leave grow more confused.

lines.zh: 我抬手，潮水在脚边等你
lines.en: I raise a hand; the tide waits at your feet.

lines.zh: 你身后的海比前面更深
lines.en: The sea behind you is deeper than ahead.

lines.zh: 我不需要追，你会自己退
lines.en: I need not chase; you will retreat on your own.

lines.zh: 杖头的光在水面拉长
lines.en: The staff's light stretches on the water.

lines.zh: 三面都有影子，第四面是海
lines.en: Three sides are shadows; the fourth is sea.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖已经泡在水里
lines.en: Your knees are already in the water.

lines.zh: 我把浪压平，看得更清
lines.en: I flatten the waves to see you better.

lines.zh: 再往后退，就是我的地方
lines.en: Back further and you are in my ground.

lines.zh: 杖头一亮，海水炸开
lines.en: The staff kindles and the sea bursts.

lines.zh: 湿袖甩出去，像一条鞭
lines.en: My wet sleeve lashes out like a whip.

lines.zh: 我抬手，水从指间射出去
lines.en: I raise a hand and water shoots from my fingers.

lines.zh: 袍下的触须抽在你腿上
lines.en: A tendril from under my robe whips your leg.

lines.zh: 我推了一掌，浪把你推倒
lines.en: I push a palm and the wave knocks you down.

lines.zh: 你砍开我的袍子，里面没有血
lines.en: You cut my robe open; there is no blood.

lines.zh: 我散成影子，从你背后合上
lines.en: I scatter and close again behind you.

lines.zh: 杖尾敲在你的腕上
lines.en: The staff's butt raps your wrist.

lines.zh: 我一挥手，湿沙溅你一脸
lines.en: I wave a hand and wet sand splashes your face.

lines.zh: 杖头的光炸在你胸前
lines.en: The staff's light bursts on your chest.

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫你的膝
lines.en: My robe's hem sweeps your knee.

lines.zh: 我抬手一推，水墙压过去
lines.en: I push and a wall of water bears down.

lines.zh: 你砍空了一刀，水花四起
lines.en: Your cut lands on nothing; spray flies.

lines.zh: 我从水里抽出另一只手
lines.en: I draw my other hand out of the water.

lines.zh: 海水先涨，然后我才出现
lines.en: The sea rises first; then I appear.

lines.zh: 我从退潮的缝里走出来
lines.en: I walk out of the gap left by the ebb.

lines.zh: 袍帽抬起，里面是暗的
lines.en: My hood lifts; inside is dark.

lines.zh: 法杖插进沙里，站住了
lines.en: My staff plants in the sand and holds.

lines.zh: 岸上的风吹不动我
lines.en: The shore wind cannot move me.

lines.zh: 远处的大群在回应我
lines.en: The swarm answers me from far off.

lines.zh: 湿沙上留下两行不整齐的印
lines.en: Two uneven lines of prints mark the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我的到来让海鸟全飞了
lines.en: My arrival scatters the seabirds.

lines.zh: 我从浪里直起身体
lines.en: I rise upright out of a wave.

lines.zh: 袍子上的水往下淌成线
lines.en: Water runs off my robe in lines.

lines.zh: 我把杖头在沙上一划
lines.en: I draw the staff's head across the sand.

lines.zh: 岸边浮起一层白沫
lines.en: A layer of white foam lifts at the shore.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看向村子的方向
lines.en: I raise my head toward the village.

lines.zh: 潮水比刚才高了一指
lines.en: The tide is a finger higher than before.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水面上不散
lines.en: My shadow does not break on the water.

lines.zh: 有人听见潮声，走出来看
lines.en: Someone hears the surf and comes out to look.

lines.zh: 我把袍角抖开，水洒了一地
lines.en: I shake out my hem and water scatters.

lines.zh: 我站在最高的一块礁石上
lines.en: I stand on the highest reef.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，海面沉了一下
lines.en: I raise a hand and the sea's surface dips.

lines.zh: 我来了，带着整片潮水
lines.en: I come, and the whole tide comes with me.

lines.zh: 火碰到我的湿衣，蒸出一片白气
lines.en: Fire meets my wet cloth and a white steam rises.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上落下，砸进浅水
lines.en: I fall from the reef into shallow water.

lines.zh: 水本是我的家，可这深度太深了
lines.en: Water is my home, but this depth is too deep.

lines.zh: 爆风把海水掀成墙，我被拍倒
lines.en: The blast lifts the sea into a wall that knocks me down.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过袍子，扎进去
lines.en: An arrow passes through my robe and bites.

lines.zh: 那股咒力在海里烧，我缩了一下
lines.en: That magic burns in the water and I flinch.

lines.zh: 我已经不吃东西，可身体还记得饿
lines.en: I no longer eat, but the body recalls hunger.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，顺着水通到我身上
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and runs through the water to me.

lines.zh: 潮水散开，脚下没有底
lines.en: The tide parts and there is no floor beneath.
